articles.title: Eurozone Sentix Investor Confidence Turns Positive
articles.expand: Eurozone investor confidence returned to positive territory in August, driven by robust economic data, survey data from the behavioral research institute Sentix showed Monday. The sentix Economic Sentiment Index rose to 0.9 in August from -3.1 in July. The score was expected to improve to -0.7.

articles.title: RBA preview: Hawkish hold widely expected; traders attentive to potential dovish surprises
articles.expand: The Reserve Bank of Australia is widely expected to keep the Cash Rate unchanged tomorrow at 4.35% following a series of soft economic data. On the inflation side, the Q2 CPI saw the Trimmed-Mean CPI Y/Y coming at 3.6%, which is lower than RBA's 3.8% forecast. articles.title: Eurozone Retail Sales Fall Unexpectedly
articles.expand: Eurozone retail sales declined unexpectedly in June after rising moderately in May, suggesting a meagre contribution by consumption to economic growth, official data revealed Thursday. Retail sales decreased 0.3 percent in June from May, Eurostat reported. Sales had increased 0.4 percent in May but fell 0.4 percent in April.
